verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is explicitly built for agentic/AI use cases and exposes a documented SDK (@vercel/sandbox), CLI, and REST API (openapi.json) for programmatic control—creating sandboxes, running commands, streaming logs, managing files, images, and persistence. This directly satisfies driving the product via a documented public API for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs/probe checks.
